description: List every product screen and marketing page in the live interactive demo catalog with its page id, approval state (approved or waiting), signed-in flag, and browser readiness check result. Use when a user wants to review demo pages, pick candidates to approve, or fix pages that failed browser checks. Read-only.

status.description: Filter pages by state: 'all' (default), 'approved' (live in demos), 'waiting' (candidates awaiting approval), or 'failed' (failed browser readiness check).

name: demopage_list_pages
title: List product demo pages and readiness checks
